title: 第三章    制作药丸
content_zh:
“你。。。”刘月听着陈木的口气，竟然一时间不知道回什么话，或许陈木的想法是对的，刘月看着陈木，叹了一口气，说道：“陈木，就在昨天，宫家的人已经去你们陈家提出退亲了，我过来就是想告诉你这件事，我希望你能够平静对待这件事，不要自暴自弃。”

    说着刘月将手上包好的三千块钱放到了陈木的书桌上，他没有告诉陈木宫家的人之后说了一些什么，同样也没有告诉陈木，陈家的人是怎么说他的，刘月怕陈木受不了打击。

    刘月已经听说了陈木已经连续酗酒两个礼拜，甚至昨天喝道胃穿孔，还好今天看起来没事，只不过刘月却怕陈木再次自暴自弃，做一些极端的事情来，这不是刘月想看到的。

    刘月没有多留，他知道现在说再多，看陈木的样子恐怕也不会听得进去。说完便离开了。

    陈木看着刘月离开的背影，同样想起来了自己这桩定亲，这是陈家给自己定的，不过现在已经不是陈家的人，宫家的人自然不会让自己的女儿嫁给自己。

    虽然这个自己从未蒙面的未婚妻，号称燕京第一美女，但陈木却没有丝毫兴趣，陈木在苍月大陆可谓是顶尖高手，美到逆天的绝世佳人也见过。

    想到这里，陈木总感觉自己似乎忽略了一个人，只是这个人自己怎么想也想不出来了。

    想不起来，陈木也不想多想，深呼了一口气后，陈木重新打量了一番自己的体内，确认自己确实是练气一层，苦笑了一番，没想到自己堂堂一个渡劫高手，竟然会沦落到现在这步田地。

    尝试着修炼一番，陈木发现这个称为“地球”的星球，灵气竟然低到竟然发指的地步，如果照这种修炼的进度，恐怕就算是一百年后，自己都不可能突破练气期，更别说更高级别的筑基期、金丹期了。。。

    陈木思索了一会，叹了口气，自己对这个星球的所知，也仅限于这个身体原本的记忆，现在最重要的还是要以最快的速度了解这个星球。
content_en:
"You..." Listening to Chen Mu's tone, Liu Yue didn't know what to say for a moment. Maybe Chen Mu's idea was right. Liu Yue looked at Chen Mu, sighed, and said, "Chen Mu, just yesterday, people from the Gong family went to your Chen family to cancel the engagement. I came here just to tell you this. I hope you can treat this matter calmly and don't give up on yourself."

As he spoke, Liu Yue put the three thousand yuan wrapped in his hand on Chen Mu's desk. He did not tell Chen Mu what the Gong family said after that, nor did he tell Chen Mu what the Chen family said about him. Liu Yue was afraid that Chen Mu would not be able to bear the blow.

Liu Yue had already heard that Chen Mu had been drinking for two weeks and even suffered a gastric perforation yesterday. Fortunately, he seemed fine today, but Liu Yue was afraid that Chen Mu would give up on himself again and do something extreme. This was not what Liu Yue wanted to see.

Liu Yue didn't stay long. He knew that no matter how much he said now, Chen Mu might not be able to listen to him.After saying that, he left.

Chen Mu looked at Liu Yue's leaving figure and also thought of his own engagement. It was arranged for him by the Chen family, but now that he was no longer a member of the Chen family, the Gong family would naturally not let their daughter marry him.

Although this fiancée, whom he had never masked before, was known as the most beautiful woman in Yanjing, Chen Mu was not interested at all. Chen Mu was a top expert in Cangyue Continent and had seen even the most beautiful women in the world.

Thinking of this, Chen Mu always felt that he seemed to have ignored someone, but he couldn't think of this person no matter how hard he thought about it.

He couldn't remember, and Chen Mu didn't want to think too much. After taking a deep breath, Chen Mu looked at his body again and confirmed that he was indeed at the first level of Qi training. He smiled bitterly. He didn't expect that he, a master of overcoming tribulations, would be reduced to this state.

After trying some cultivation, Chen Mu discovered that the aura of this planet called "Earth" was incredibly low. If he continued at this pace of cultivation, he would not be able to break through the Qi training stage even in a hundred years, let alone the higher-level foundation building stage and golden elixir stage...

Chen Mu thought for a while and sighed. What he knew about this planet was limited to the original memory of this body. The most important thing now was to understand this planet as quickly as possible.
